import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, filename='data_scrape.log', filemode='a', format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s')

def scrape_reddit_comment(url):
    """Scrapes a Reddit comment and extracts personal information."""
    try:
        response = requests.get(url)
        response.raise_for_status()
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')

        text = soup.get_text()

        # Extract personal data using regex
        phone_number_pattern = r'\d{3}[-\.\s]??\d{3}[-\.\s]??\d{4}\b'
        date_pattern = r'\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{2,4}'
        location_pattern = r'\b(city|town|state|region|county)\b\s*([A-Za-z]+(?: [A-Za-z]+)*)'

        phone_numbers = re.findall(phone_number_pattern, text)
        dates = re.findall(date_pattern, text)
        locations = re.findall(location_pattern, text)

        data = {}
        if phone_numbers:
            data['Phone Numbers'] = phone_numbers
        if dates:
            data['Dates'] = dates
        if locations:
            data['Locations'] = locations

        if data:
            logging.info(f"Found personal data on {url}: {data}")
            return data
        else:
            return None
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        logging.error(f"Request Error on {url}: {e}")
        return None
    except Exception as e:
        logging.error(f"Error processing {url}: {e}")
        return None

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example usage:
    url1 = "https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/x123y45/hello_reddit/"  # Replace with a valid subreddit and comment ID
    url2 = "https://www.reddit.com/r/programming/comments/abcdefg/" # Example Reddit URL

    scrape_reddit_comment(url2)

    print("Scraping and logging completed. Check data_scrape.log for details.")
